bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative discussion using conceptual examples to demonstrate how large language models impose English-centric cultural concepts (e.g., generating 'bacon and eggs' as a typical breakfast food in Urdu) due to Western-dominated training data.

Theoretical analysis and literature review evaluating the systemic bias towards English in machine translation training data, leading to the marginalization of lesser-resourced languages and a loss of linguistic richness and diversity.
